snippet.title: Team Death let me preview the HUGE 1st anniversary patch for the Simulator! 🖤 | Kingdom Death
snippet.description:
as you can probably imagine for a fangirl like me, working with Team Death was something of a bucket-list opportunity! 🖤 now i can kick back and see what else is coming for Black Friday!

00:00 Kingdom Death: Simulator
02:36 what's new this black friday?
04:45 mysterious heirlooms
08:30 the keysmith is awake

i also post (free) b-side videos on my Patreon: http://patreon.com/anawfulfeeling 

#kingdomdeath
